title: A Call to Repentance

questions.question: "If a man divorces his wife and she goes from him and becomes another man's wife, will he return to her? Would not that land be greatly...?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:1 (ESV): "Would not that land be greatly polluted?"

questions.question: "You have played the... with many lovers; and would you return to me? declares the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:1 (ESV): "You have played the whore with many lovers; and would you return to me?"

questions.question: "You have polluted the land with your vile harlotry. Therefore the showers have been withheld, and the... has not come."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:3 (ESV): "Therefore the showers have been withheld, and the spring rain has not come;"

questions.question: The Lord said to Jeremiah in the days of King Josiah: "Have you seen what she did, that faithless one, Israel, how she went up on every high hill and under every green tree, and there...?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:6 (ESV): "how she went up on every high hill and under every green tree, and there played the whore?"

questions.question: Who saw all of Israel's adulteries and yet did not fear, but went and played the whore also?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:7 (ESV): "And her treacherous sister Judah saw it."

questions.question: What did the Lord give faithless Israel for all her adulteries?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:8 (ESV): "She saw that for all the adulteries of that faithless one, Israel, I had sent her away with a decree of divorce."

questions.question: "Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:11 (ESV): "And the Lord said to me, 'Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.'"

questions.question: "Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, 'Return, faithless Israel, declares the Lord. I will not look on you in anger, for I am..., declares the Lord.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:12 (ESV): "I will not look on you in anger, for I am merciful, declares the Lord."

questions.question: "Only acknowledge your... that you rebelled against the Lord your God..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:13 (ESV): "Only acknowledge your guilt, that you rebelled against the Lord your God"

questions.question: "Return, O faithless children, declares the Lord; for I am your...; I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:14 (ESV): "Return, O faithless children, declares the Lord; for I am your master;"

questions.question: "And I will give you... after my own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:15 (ESV): "And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding."

questions.question: "In those days... they shall no more say, 'The... of the covenant of the Lord.' It shall not come to mind..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:16 (ESV): "they shall no more say, 'The ark of the covenant of the Lord.' It shall not come to mind or be remembered or missed;"

questions.question: "At that time Jerusalem shall be called the... of the Lord, and all nations shall gather to it..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:17 (ESV): "At that time Jerusalem shall be called the throne of the Lord, and all nations shall gather to it,"

questions.question: "In those days the house of Judah shall join the house of Israel, and together they shall come from the land of the north to the land that I gave your fathers for a..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:18 (ESV): "to the land that I gave your fathers for a heritage."

questions.question: "Return, O faithless sons; I will heal your... "
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 3:22 (ESV): ""Return, O faithless sons; I will heal your faithlessness.""

key_verse_text: "Return, O faithless sons; I will heal your faithlessness." "Behold, we come to you, for you are the Lord our God."
